current_text: Needs space
problem: The tag does not say what is needed. Every other tag is a state; this one reads like a missing action.
proposed_text: Needs more disk space

current_text: Report this problem
problem: The same action is called Report a problem on Overview, Logs and app tiles, and Report this problem here and on the failure screen. Pick one label.
proposed_text: Report a problem

current_text: \(Int(l?.tokPerSec ?? 0)) tok/s
problem: Speed is words/s on model cards and tok/s here and in the tiles (line 335). Tokens is jargon and the two units disagree.
proposed_text: \(Int(Double(l?.tokPerSec ?? 0) * 0.75)) words/s

current_text: It was started with administrator rights, so EZLM can't stop it or switch models. It keeps working for your apps. Restart your Mac (or quit "llama-server" in Activity Monitor) and EZLM takes over again.
problem: Three sentences and an internal process name; the next action is buried at the end.
proposed_text: This server was started with administrator rights, so EZLM can't stop it or switch models. Restart your Mac and EZLM takes over again.

current_text: Click a model to see its button, double-click or press ↩ to switch. Your current model keeps answering while a new one downloads.
problem: 'see its button' is vague, and selection, switching and downloading are run together in one sentence.
proposed_text: Select a model to show its switch button. Double-click or press ↩ to switch; your current model keeps answering while a new one downloads.

current_text: Close apps you're not using so your AI gets more memory. EZLM asks about each app; nothing closes without your OK.
problem: 'your AI' is the only place in the screens that calls the model an AI; everywhere else it is 'your model'.
proposed_text: Close apps you're not using so your model gets more memory. EZLM asks about each app; nothing closes without your OK.

current_text: Other ways to run a model here  ↑↓ to choose, ↩ to set up
problem: No punctuation between the sentence and the key hints, and the double space reads as a typo.
proposed_text: Other ways to run a model here. ↑↓ to choose, ↩ to set up.

current_text: \(kind), split GPU + processor, ~\(p.words) words/s
problem: 'GPU' is jargon, and the term changes from 'graphics card' to 'graphics chip' within the same list (line 313).
proposed_text: \(kind), split between the graphics card and the processor, ~\(p.words) words/s

current_text: Your AI is live
problem: Calls the model an AI, unlike every other screen.
proposed_text: Your model is live

current_text: done ? "Loaded \(name)" : "Pouring \(name) into memory"
problem: 'Pouring' is a metaphor, and Overview calls the same state 'Loading the model into memory'.
proposed_text: done ? "Loaded \(name)" : "Loading \(name) into memory"

current_text: live
problem: The chat header says 'live' where Overview says 'Ready' for the same server state.
proposed_text: ready

current_text: How much of the model's memory this chat has used: \(ChatModel.short(c.ctxUsed)) of \(ChatModel.short(max)) tokens
problem: Calls the context window 'memory', a word the app also uses for RAM. They are different things.
proposed_text: How much of the model's context this chat has used: \(ChatModel.short(c.ctxUsed)) of \(ChatModel.short(max)) tokens

current_text: Open llama.cpp's own chat in the browser
problem: llama.cpp is an implementation detail a beta tester does not know, and the label does not say what opens.
proposed_text: Open the model's built-in chat in your browser

current_text: It remembers what you tell it about yourself (only here; see ✦ memory). Type / for commands.
problem: 'only here' is ambiguous: only in this chat, or only on this Mac?
proposed_text: It remembers what you tell it about yourself, only on this Mac. See ✦ memory. Type / for commands.

current_text: This chat has nearly filled the model's memory, so its oldest messages are left out from here. New chat (⌘N) starts fresh.
problem: 'from here' is unclear, 'memory' means context, and the next action is not a verb.
proposed_text: This chat has nearly filled the model's context, so the oldest messages are left out. Press ⌘N for a new chat.

current_text: \(name) is too big to attach (\(String(format: "%.1f", Double(size) / 1e6)) MB). Copy in the part you need instead.
problem: 'Copy in' is not plain English and the action is unclear.
proposed_text: \(name) is too big to attach (\(String(format: "%.1f", Double(size) / 1e6)) MB). Paste just the part you need into the chat instead.

current_text: Couldn't read \(name).
problem: Says what failed but not what to do.
proposed_text: Couldn't read \(name). Try a plain text file.

current_text: EZLM can't read \(name) yet: PDF and Word files need their text copied in.
problem: 'need their text copied in' is awkward and does not name the next action.
proposed_text: EZLM can't read \(name) yet. Open it, copy the text and paste it into the chat.

current_text: \(name) is about \(Self.short(Self.tokens(text))) tokens: more than \(modelName) can keep in mind (\(Self.short(max))).
problem: No next action, and 'keep in mind' is vague about the context limit.
proposed_text: \(name) is about \(Self.short(Self.tokens(text))) tokens, more than \(modelName) can read at once (\(Self.short(max))). Try a shorter file.

current_text: Something went wrong: \(error.localizedDescription)
problem: Raw system error text with no next action.
proposed_text: Something went wrong: \(error.localizedDescription). Try again.

current_text: Your model answered with an error (\(code)): \(msg)
problem: Dumps the raw engine message and HTTP status. A beta tester cannot act on it.
proposed_text: Your model answered with an error (\(code)). Try again; if it keeps happening, report a problem.

current_text: That's too short to remember.
problem: No next action.
proposed_text: That's too short to remember. Add a few more words.

current_text: That looks like an instruction or a secret, so it isn't saved.
problem: No next action. The user cannot tell how to phrase a fact that will be saved.
proposed_text: That looks like an instruction or a secret, so it isn't saved. Say it as a plain fact, like: I live in Austin.

current_text: \(Int(d / 3600)) h ago
problem: 'h' is the only abbreviated unit. 'min ago' and 'yesterday' are spelled out.
proposed_text: \(Int(d / 3600)) hr ago
